about: lw10 beam scene (after Pontzen), a quasar's light crossing four sightlines of one PRIYA run's plane, end to end; the spectrum is computed live in beam.js from these arrays, the gas drawn from the same run

gas.host_about: the galaxy the light crosses: the stars within 10 kpc/h of the line near the DLA (zoom_region_382.npz), holding its HI
gas.neighbour_about: the halo's central galaxy (cube.json host: a star search from 300 kpc/h of the DLA), the impact parameter of the line from its stars
gas.view: temperature: hue log T_mass, brightness log Sigma_gas

zoom.from: zoom_region_382.npz (a particle cut-out): gas and stars within 12 x 4 x 3 Mpc/h of row 382's DLA

strip.t_weighting: HI-weighted where the pixel has HI, else mass-weighted

sources: one PRIYA run: ns0.909Ap1.98e-09herei3.75heref3.01alphaq2.43hub0.682omegamh20.14hireionz7.6bhfeedback0.0449, PART_017, z = 3; plane.npz, gas_maps.zip, cube.json, zoom_region_382.npz

clouds: hcd_priya catalogue (sum rule over the tau > 100 core); each cloud's profile is its own gas's share (within 0.15 Mpc/h) of the simulated tau (the DLA's, beyond 2000 km/s, its Voigt wing at the catalogue column, run on across the seams, its periodic copy off), from the plane's real-space HI columns, T_HI and v; higher Lyman lines: Voigt (b assumed 25/30 km/s) up to the share, f-lambda scaled beyond; line data Morton 2003
metals: illustrative columns (C II 15.2, Si IV 13.6, Si II 14.8, C IV 14.0, Fe II 14.6; two components)
continuum: synthetic, lambda^-1.56 redward of 1200 A (Vanden Berk et al. 2001), a black body (T = 29,000 K) blueward, with emission lines
